source_title: Nayanthara calls Mookuthi Amman 2 special, thanks director and producer in new note - India Today
source_excerpt:
Actor Nayanthara marked her Mookuthi Amman 2 wrap with a heartfelt note thanking the team. She called the sequel special and said she eagerly awaits its release.
Some films stay with an actor long after the cameras stop rolling, and for Nayanthara, Mookuthi Amman 2 is one such project. The actor has penned an emotional note as she wrapped up her journey on the upcoming film, thanking director Sundar C, producer Ishari K Ganesh and her co-stars for making the experience memorable.

Nayanthara's heartfelt note on Mookuthi Amman 2
Nayanthara began her note by reflecting on the special place the film holds in her heart. “Some films stay close to your heart long after the cameras stop rolling. For me, Mookuthi Amman 2 is one such film ,” she wrote.
The actor had a special word of appreciation for director Sundar C, thanking him for bringing his vision and passion to the project.
“To my director, Sundar C sir, thank you for bringing your vision, warmth and passion to this film. Working with you has been a joy. Thank you for the care you put into every moment and for making this journey so memorable. I will be forever grateful to you for this film,” she said.
She also thanked producer Ishari K Ganesh for believing in the film and supporting the team throughout the process.
“To my producer, Ishari K Ganesh Sir, thank you for believing in this film and for supporting us. Having a producer who believes in a story so wholeheartedly makes every step of the journey more meaningful,” Nayanthara wrote.
The actor also acknowledged her co-stars, including Regina Cassandra, Khushbu Sundar and Sneha. She described sharing the journey with Regina as lovely and wished her success in everything that lies ahead.
“Khushbu Ma'am and Sneha Ma'am, being part of this film with both of you is something I'll cherish. Sending you both the biggest hugs and all my love,” she added.
Nayanthara concluded by expressing gratitude to the entire cast and crew, while looking forward to the film's release.
“I feel fortunate to have shared this journey with such a wonderful cast and crew. And now, I can't wait for all of you to experience the world we've created together,” she said. All About Mookuthi Amman 2
Mookuthi Amman 2 is the sequel to the 2020 Tamil devotional comedy Mookuthi Amman , which starred Nayanthara as the titular goddess. The sequel is directed by Sundar C and produced by Ishari K Ganesh.
The film features Nayanthara alongside Regina Cassandra, Khushbu Sundar and Sneha, among others. The project has generated interest among fans eager to see Nayanthara return to the role. - Ends ALSO READ | Mookuthi Amman 2 teaser: Nayanthara returns as Goddess to battle bigger evil
